provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^315 - 1 with a(x) = x^13 + x^45 + x^56 + x^80 + x^143 + x^165 + x^187 + x^303 + x^309, b(x) = x^32 + x^36 + x^80 + x^97 + x^101 + x^148 + x^157 + x^176 + x^182 + x^202 + x^240 + x^264 + x^265; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. The submitted distance 100 was refuted by the verify gate with a weight-84 norm lift from the quotient ring x^15 - 1; the norm lift from x^63 - 1 gives weight-70 logicals on both sides, and 50M GPU RIS trials per side on the full code found nothing lighter than 84 (X) and 90 (Z).
